gate_notes: Hourly gate (RULES fixed list, loadouts.yaml: bottle_1L and gps are access: hourly): only A reaches every hourly item on every loadout and belt. B, C, D, E miss the sheep-load 2nd bottle on all belts; D also misses the GPS on S-L. CORRIE B.2 misses more (GPS, 2nd bottle, snacks on sheep; snacks on day/elk at S-L: bag_comp_C.md s5, bag_comp_lean.md s4).
Volume gate: C 88.08 L mean (88.54/88.79/86.92 at 15/19/23 in) is 0.08 L over 88.0. Same sim basis gives CORRIE B.2 87.84 L, so C is CORRIE's shell + 0.24 L.

CG gate with the flat +4 mm bias: E 15 in meat 187.4 + 4 = 191.4 mm > 190 (fails by 1.4 mm). E's case converged at 1 mm rounding; corrie_body.md 11.4 measured +0.7 mm from 1 to 0 mm rounding, which reads 188.1 mm (pass). C passes with 1.0 mm margin.

Render gate: only a missing required shot is treated as a gate fail (C). Every entry has at least one listed render defect; under a zero-defect reading of RULES item 3 all five would fail, so defects go into the look score instead.

verdict.winner_why: only entry through the gate; best function/access (0 hourly misses on every loadout x belt, door 294-334 mm clear), 15 in meat CG margin 6.4 mm with bias; costs +24 g and the most build hours (38.3 h)
verdict.runner_up_why: highest weighted score under every weighting (7.67 base) on weight, build hours and CG margin; fails the hourly gate by one item (sheep 2nd bottle) and has the weakest access and durability
verdict.if_bottle2_not_hourly: if the owner rules the sheep 2nd bottle a reserve (not hourly), B passes the gate and wins on points; C still fails (volume, missing render) and E still fails on the flat-bias CG
